rachel: quick note - found a subtle telemetry redaction gap in the Node sample app when auth retry replays headers. reproducer below.

rachel: repro (tiny):
```
# start sample server with verbose telemetry
DEBUG=redwood:telemetry node samples/header-repro/server.js
# cause auth failure that triggers retry replay
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer bad' http://localhost:4321/ping
```

devon: can you paste the exact log lines that still show the request id?

rachel: minimal sanitized log:
```
2026-03-23T09:14:10.100Z info telemetry inbound scrub X-Request-ID: <redacted>
2026-03-23T09:14:10.130Z warn auth failed -> retrying
2026-03-23T09:14:10.131Z debug retry-wrapper replaying headers: X-Request-ID=2f9e4a
2026-03-23T09:14:10.132Z info http response logged X-Request-ID=2f9e4a
```

priya: looks like retry-wrapper is reusing an earlier header snapshot. which sdk & shim versions?

rachel: node-sdk@1.8.0, otel-shim@0.4.2. retry-wrapper stores a headersCopy on first attempt to speed replays; the OTEL inbound scrub hook mutates req.headers after that snapshot is made.

devon: python was fine because its retry reads req.headers at replay time. i bet we missed a contract that scrubbing should happen before snapshot or snapshot should be deferred.

telemetry-bot: auto-alert: header-redaction-suspect for trace 0x9abc (info). ticket RW-1112 created.

priya: short-term mitigations: 1) change retry to read headers from the live req object at replay time (preferred), 2) run redaction in a later outbound hook, or 3) add explicit scrub step inside retry before emit.

rachel: I implemented option 1 locally and added a tiny integration test that simulates auth failure+retry and greps debug logs for unredacted X-Request-ID. test fails on master, passes with the change. i'll open a PR with: failing test, fix, and test passing.

devon: please mark the integration test flaky/skip on windows and add to samples CI. also add a unit asserting retry does not use a pre-scrub header snapshot.

priya: add an entry in release notes: "fix(node-sdk): avoid replaying pre-scrubbed headers during auth retry" and file RW-1113 to add cross-SDK e2e telemetry parity checks.

rachel: done. PR inbound, pinging @eng-platform for review. thanks!
